intake.name: Dataset Intake Assessment
intake.description: Capture, assess, and decide go/kill on a candidate raw dataset before it enters the cleansing pipeline. A go verdict registers the dataset and hands off to 01-audit.md; a kill closes it. Lives under instances/<name>/intake/<slug>/
intake.author: spec-kit-core

issue.name: Data Issue Triage Workflow
issue.description: Assess, resolve, and verify data quality issues found in a dataset after it has passed 05-implement.md, with per-issue reports stored under instances/<name>/datasets/<dataset_id>/issues/<slug>/
issue.author: spec-kit-core

agent-context.name: Coding Agent Context
agent-context.description: Manages coding agent context/instruction files (e.g., CLAUDE.md, copilot-instructions.md) with project-specific plan references and configurable markers
agent-context.author: spec-kit-core

assess.name: Idea Assessment Pipeline
assess.description: [Software-delivery variant — superseded for this data cleansing methodology by 'intake'] Assess an idea before Spec-Driven Development via intake, research, define, shape, and decide. A go verdict hands off to /speckit.specify; a kill closes it. Lives under .specify/assessments/<slug>/
assess.author: spec-kit-core

bug.name: Bug Triage Workflow
bug.description: [Software-delivery variant — superseded for this data cleansing methodology by 'issue'] Assess, fix, and validate bug reports against the codebase with per-bug reports stored under .specify/bugs/<slug>/
bug.author: spec-kit-core

git.name: Git Branching Workflow
git.description: Feature branch creation, numbering (sequential/timestamp), validation, and Git remote detection
git.author: spec-kit-core
